paper_title: Extended Search for the Invisible Axion with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
notes: ADMX cavity haloscope excludes DFSZ axion-photon coupling over mass range 2.81-3.31 ueV (680-790 MHz region; overall DFSZ coverage 2.66-3.31 ueV). The exclusion limit is at DFSZ sensitivity across the band. Numerical g_agamma values are not tabulated; the DFSZ coupling at ~740 MHz corresponds to roughly g_agamma ~ 3-4e-16 GeV^-1. Data points are approximate horizontal band at the DFSZ level spanning the excluded mass range (2.81 ueV = 1.163e-5 eV to 3.31 ueV = 1.37e-5 eV). Actual limit curve is in Fig. 4 which is not numerically available. Two DM density models used: 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (Maxwell-Boltzmann) and 0.63 GeV/cm^3 (N-body). | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.78, 26)) | Vision: Green 'This work' region spans ~677-800 MHz.
